sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: MobileDay was a mobile-phone application that reminded users about meetings across their calendars and made dialing into meetings easier. The service shut down in 2021.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: MobileDay has shut down. Its team said the application helped users remember meetings across their calendars, dial in, and manage their day using a mobile phone.

sections.label: Voice & tone
sections.content: Friendly and informal, with a warm farewell-oriented tone.

sections.label: Problem solved
sections.content: Meeting attendees needed an easier way to remember meetings across multiple calendars and dial into them from a mobile phone.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Meeting reminders across calendars
Mobile-phone meeting dial-in
Meeting and day management

sections.label: Use cases
sections.content:
Reminding users about meetings across their calendars
Dialing into meetings from a mobile phone
Managing the day through a mobile phone

sections.label: Customer outcomes
sections.content:
Easier meeting dial-in and connection
Improved meeting reminders across calendars
Simpler day management
